title: Extract adjacent offset tables
changes: Publish and serve five independently rooted European offset tables as typed original bytes while keeping guest indexing and arithmetic unchanged. Five bytes were unowned in the E172 sample.
validation: Source e194-offset-source-r364fmf9 authenticates all 32 bytes and the successor. Wine e194-offset-trace-wine-uxtnxes3 observes four tables; e194-offset-wine-ug76r3cd preserves 122 other resources, rejects coherent edits, checks altered and mixed reads and compares six interpreter/native readers, including signed-byte cases.

Wine e194-offset-scene-wine-dh8ic7ya matches full state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio for 600 frames with all 32 source bytes altered. Wine e194-offset-cli-wine-7ind1kk9 creates, reuses and verifies 124 matching files.
limitations: Reader and scene logs contain D-Bus pending-call assertions before successful completion; cause unestablished. Ordinary trace observed four of five tables through interpreter fallback; the fifth was covered by a controlled original reader. Other consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurements were performed.
